components.css: .ds-strip{display:flex;align-items:stretch;height:48px;background:var(--color-strip,#ecdfc2);color:var(--color-strip-ink,#2a2015);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 6px 14px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.7);outline:2px solid transparent;transition:outline-color .18s}.ds-strip:hover{outline-color:var(--color-amber,#e8a93a)}.ds-strip-id{width:10.5rem;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:0 10px;border-right:1px solid rgba(42,32,21,.15)}.ds-strip-call{font:600 14px/1 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.025em}.ds-strip-tag{font:400 10px/1 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.05em;color:rgba(42,32,21,.65)}.ds-strip-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-top:4px}.ds-strip-name{font:400 12px/1 'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif}.ds-strip-status{font:600 11px/1 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.025em;color:var(--color-clearance-dim,#a13f13)}.ds-strip-track{flex:1;display:flex;gap:1px;padding:4px 12px 4px 0}.ds-strip-track i{flex:1 1 0;border-radius:1px}.ds-strip-track i.ds-closed{flex:0 0 1.5px;background:rgba(42,32,21,.28)}.ds-strip-track i.ds-win{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-clearance,#d4551c)}

components.name: Clearance Stamp
components.description: The signature mark: lands with an overshooting spring when the decision becomes official; filled with scope glass.
components.css: @keyframes ds-stamp-land{from{transform:scale(1.9) rotate(8deg);opacity:0}70%{transform:scale(.96) rotate(-4.5deg);opacity:1}to{transform:scale(1) rotate(-4deg);opacity:1}}.ds-stamp{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:10px 24px;border:3px solid var(--color-clearance,#d4551c);border-radius:2px;background:var(--color-glass,#0c131d);color:var(--color-clearance,#d4551c);transform:rotate(-4deg);animation:ds-stamp-land .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}.ds-stamp:hover{animation:none;transform:rotate(-4deg) scale(1.02)}.ds-stamp-word{font:700 48px/1 'Big Shoulders Display',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em}.ds-stamp-detail{margin-top:4px;font:600 14px/1 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.2em}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-stamp{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
MeetMind is a control tower after dark. The ground is a steel-blue console board; the radar scope is a darker pane of glass set into it; live traffic is amber phosphor; people are manila flight strips racked in a bay; and safety orange appears only when something is closed, called, or cleared. The screen shows the mechanism at work: every agent is an aircraft, every candidate time a fix on the rim, and the decision is a landing followed by an ink stamp.

Density is operational. Small mono readouts, hairline rules and tight strip rows sit beside one large instrument (the scope) and a few loud display-face statements (the event title, the cleared time, the stamp). Contrast comes from the material, not from effects. Phosphor is drawn as afterglow on the canvas, never as CSS glow. Strips lift off the board with a soft drop shadow, and panels are outlined in hairlines. Nothing is blurred or glassy.

The identity is binding (PRODUCT.md): go deeper into the tower and person-card world rather than replacing it.
keyCharacteristics: Steel-blue board, darker scope glass, manila strips, amber live traffic, orange reserved for closure and clearance.
Three faces, three jobs: Big Shoulders Display announces, Plex Mono reads out data, Plex Sans speaks prose.
Hairline borders and 2px corners everywhere; the only round shapes are the scope and status pips.
Motion runs on a continuous sweep, critically damped flight and one-shot pulses, and every animation respects reduced motion.

rules.name: The Reserved Orange Rule
rules.body: Safety orange marks closures, clearances, tower calls, the runway, the winning cell, primary actions and the stamp, and nothing else. If an element is merely important, use amber or manila instead.

rules.name: The Signal-for-Text Rule
rules.body: Orange text on the board is always `signal`, and orange text on manila is always `clearance-dim`. Raw `clearance` appears as text only inside the stamp.

rules.name: The Ink-Not-Orange Rule
rules.body: Scores are inked manila → amber → amber-brown. A high score is never orange, because orange already means "closed" or "cleared".

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Plex Mono is for data only (scores, times, callsigns, readouts, controls). Plex Sans is for prose. Big Shoulders Display is for titles, the cleared time and the stamp. A sentence set in mono, or a number set in display, is wrong.

rules.name: The Heading-Is-The-Label Rule
rules.body: A small tracked mono label is allowed as a panel's own heading or a list's own heading. It never sits above a display heading as an eyebrow.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: No CSS glows, no blur or frosted plates, and no coloured halos. Phosphor afterglow belongs to the canvas sweep. Ink, text and borders never emit light.

dos: **Do** reserve `clearance` for closures, clearances, tower calls, the runway, the winning cell, primary actions and the stamp.
**Do** use `signal` for orange text on the board and `clearance-dim` for orange text on manila.
**Do** ink scores along the manila → amber → amber-brown ramp.
**Do** set data in Plex Mono with tabular figures, prose in Plex Sans, and titles, the cleared time and the stamp in Big Shoulders Display.
**Do** fill anything that sits on the scope with `glass`.
**Do** separate panels on the board with 1px `board-line` hairlines and 2px corners, and let only manila cast shadows.
**Do** give every timed or looping motion a reduced-motion path that jumps to the end state.
donts: **Don't** set a high score, a leading time or emphasis in safety orange.
**Don't** use raw `clearance` as small text on the board or on manila.
**Don't** put a small tracked label above a heading as an eyebrow.
**Don't** add glows, blur or frosted plates, or coloured halos.
**Don't** use coloured side borders as accents. The orange routing stripe belongs only on a manila card's top edge.
**Don't** use text glyphs (✓, →) as icons. Draw icons as inline 16px-grid SVG strokes.
**Don't** label simulated agents as real. SIM tags and the SIMULATED AGENTS chip stay visible.
